canonical_example.text: Wat je nu doet haalt geen donder uit!
canonical_example.translation: What you're doing right now isn't achieving a thing!

meanings.translation: a thing (as in not a single thing)

canonical_example.text: De leerling verloor zijn evenwicht en donderde achterover van zijn stoel.
canonical_example.translation: The pupil lost his balance and tumbled backwards off his chair.

canonical_example.text: In de verte hoor ik het donderen.
canonical_example.translation: I can hear it thunder in the distance.

canonical_example.text: 'Hou daar nu mee op!', donderde de man.
canonical_example.translation: 'Stop that right now!', thundered the man.

unused_menu_senses.translation: to make a thunderous sound, especially with one's voice

canonical_example.text: De verkoop van het nieuwe product overtrof alle verwachtingen.
canonical_example.translation: The sale of the new product exceeded all expectations.

canonical_example.text: De nieuwe broeken verkopen goed.
canonical_example.translation: The new trousers sell well.

meanings.translation: to sell, to be sold, to be saleable

canonical_example.text: Ik ga mijn oude fiets verkopen omdat ik een nieuwe wil.
canonical_example.translation: I am going to sell my old bike because I want a new one.

canonical_example.text: Als je zo doorgaat, zal ze je een klap verkopen.
canonical_example.translation: If you continue like this, she'll hit you.

canonical_example.translation: He had trouble convincing the group of his story.

unused_menu_senses.translation: to make something believable, to convince (sell an idea/belief)

canonical_example.text: de temperatuur opnemen
canonical_example.translation: to measure the temperature

canonical_example.translation: Who is going to answer/pick up the phone.

meanings.translation: to pick up or answer (the phone or horn)

canonical_example.translation: to initiate contact with someone

canonical_example.text: Ze nam een foto van de zonsondergang op.

canonical_example.translation: We initially intended for him to join (literally: be taken onboard) our partnership.

canonical_example.translation: Where are you going, beauty?

canonical_example.translation: Beauty is so relative; what one finds beautiful, another finds incredibly ugly.

canonical_example.translation: The customer is always king in this store.

canonical_example.translation: After many setbacks, they hoped for a reversal of luck.

canonical_example.translation: She becomes friendlier each time I see her.
